name: HC25: No. active on ART who are Malnourished at the last visit and linked to nutrition support during the reporting quarter
description: Malnourished active ART clients linked to nutrition support during the reporting quarter. Excludes clients who declined enrollment after nutrition counselling. Counts unique active ART patients whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter documented moderate or severe acute malnutrition and who were linked to nutrition support through therapeutic feeding, supplementary feeding, infant feeding counselling, or nutrition counselling.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:

  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",

  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,

    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    /* Active on ART */
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    /* HIV patient */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )

    /* Has started ART */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )

    /* Last visit in reporting quarter */
    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
          AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )

    /* Malnourished */
    AND a.nutrition_assesment IN (
        'SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION',

        'MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION'
    )

        'INFANT FEEDING COUNSELING',
        'NUTRITION COUNSELLING ONLY >2YRS',
        'THERAPEUTIC FEEDING',
        'Supplementary Feeding'
    );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    /* Active on ART */
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    /* HIV patient */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )

    /* Has started ART */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )

    /* Last visit in reporting quarter */
    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
          AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )

    /* Malnourished */
    AND a.nutrition_assesment IN (
        'SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION',
        'SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA',
        'MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION'
    )

    /* Linked to nutrition support */
    AND a.nutrition_support_and_infant_feeding IN (
        'INFANT FEEDING COUNSELING',
        'NUTRITION COUNSELLING ONLY >2YRS',
        'THERAPEUTIC FEEDING',
        'Supplementary Feeding'
    );
